transverse_myelitis.description: Patients with transverse myelitis, unspecified myelitis, or neuromyelitis optica based on diagnosis evidence.

items.rationale: The standard concept 'Transverse myelopathy syndrome' (443904) in SNOMED represents the clinical description of transverse myelitis, including its descendants such as 'Acute transverse myelitis', 'Complete transverse myelitis', 'Varicella transverse myelitis', and 'Idiopathic transverse myelitis'. This concept set comprehensively covers the specified conditions.
